name: Cockatrice
summary: A small monstrosity whose bite slowly turns creatures to stone.

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}. *First Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {ref:condition/restrained}, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/petrified} condition, instead of the {ref:condition/restrained} condition, for 24 hours.
